newsitem.title: USA: US Airways reduces some fares.
newsitem.headline: US Airways reduces some fares.

text.p: US Airways Group Inc said Thursday it lowered round-trip ticket prices today for travel between Philadelphia and Florida and the Caribbean.
The company said Florida fares are as low as $178 round-trip and Caribbean fares are as low as $229 round-trip.
The fares are available to cuatomers traveling between April 10 and June 12, the company said.
Tickets must be purchased at least 14 days prior to departure and no later than April 3, the company said.
Travel must be round-trip with at least one Saturday night stay, the company said.
Tickets are non-refundable, the company said.
